items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: Johnny Clegg — do you know who Johnny Clegg was? You know quite a cultural hero and a unique individual on many levels, got together the South African — SAMA — South African Music Association.

ctx.x: Did you agree with the Artists United Against Apartheid? Did you feel that that refusal to come in ensuing years was a positive or a negative?

Well the UDF, the United Democratic Front, which was an open organization, it wasn’t a banned organization like the ANC, the African National Congress. The United Democratic Front always kind of apologetically said to the South African public that a boycott is a blunt instrument and you know we can’t always choose between the good guys and the bad guys, so you know we’ll just say a boycott’s a boycott. But then there were so many individual exceptions that refined — made the blunt instrument rather surgical. But…
maneuver to say well it’s an independent country. You know a casino state. There were several such.
